file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) console executable for MS Windows (MinGW-w64 GCC 13, stripped, 10 sections)

injection_details.target_discovery: CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS=0x2) then Process32First/Process32Next loop comparing PROCESSENTRY32.szExeFile (offset 0x2C) to 'explorer.exe' via strcmp; PID saved from th32ProcessID (offset 0x8)
injection_details.payload_write: OpenProcess(0x42A) -> VirtualAllocEx(hProc, 0, strlen(payload)+1, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE(0x3000), PAGE_READWRITE(0x04)) -> WriteProcessMemory(hProc, remoteBuf, payload, strlen+1, &written)
injection_details.execution: CreateRemoteThread(hProc, NULL, 0, LoadLibraryA, remoteBuf, 0, NULL); WaitForSingleObject(hThread, INFINITE); CloseHandle(hThread); CloseHandle(hProc)
injection_details.payload: XOR-decrypted 32-byte DLL path string written into the remote process and passed to LoadLibraryA
injection_details.api_resolution: All 10 injection APIs (CreateToolhelp32Snapshot, Process32First, Process32Next, OpenProcess, VirtualAllocEx, WriteProcessMemory, CreateRemoteThread, CloseHandle, WaitForSingleObject, LoadLibraryA) resolved at runtime by manual PE export-table walking of kernel32.dll (GetModuleHandleA is the only kernel32 import used for this)

encryption_details.algorithm: Custom repeating-key XOR (byte-wise, in-place; key[i] applied as data[i] ^= key[i % keylen])
encryption_details.key_storage: Hardcoded in .rdata at RVA 0x4000 (VA 0x140004000), stored as the 8 bytes immediately preceding the plaintext 'kernel32.dll' string; 32-byte ciphertext resides in .data at VA 0x140003000 (file offset 0x2400)

anti_analysis: peb_antidebug: reads PEB via gs:[0x60] and tests PEB+0x2 (BeingDebugged); if a debugger is present the decrypt/inject routine returns immediately without injecting
xor_string_obfuscation: injected DLL path is encrypted with an 8-byte repeating-XOR key

api_obfuscation / manual_getprocaddress: all process-injection APIs are resolved at runtime by walking kernel32's export directory, so they do not appear in the import table (only GetModuleHandleA is imported)
tls_callbacks: TLS callback array present (VA 0x140009038) with CRT callbacks at 0x140001cc0/0x140001c90
anti-analysis_gating: injection only occurs when BeingDebugged flag is clear
